pin_semantics: model_revision is a base HF repository commit. adapter_revision is the released adapter HF repository commit. adapter_archive_sha256 hashes a model-specific tar.gz. adapter_weight_sha256 hashes adapter_model.safetensors only.
Training seeds0/1/2 are distinct from behavior seed bases1000/2000, random-direction seeds, and analysis/bootstrap seeds.
Requirements-only pins are not independent execution receipts. CUDA cu130 is a wheel/index tag, not an independently observed CUDA runtime or driver version. Missing versions remain null.

The released32B historical training torch/transformers versions and exact kernels were explicitly unverified in frozen_recipe.json /historical_unverified. Do not apply evaluation pins retroactively to released-adapter training.

Additional-seed recipe status records an earlier blocked stage; final saved adapter digests and evaluation configuration identify the exported completed evaluation inputs. No public repository revision is invented for locally trained adapters.
Geometry has23 usable archived activation labels and2 preserved exclusions; its author code revision must not be presented as all23 model revisions.
Reset groups use unadapted instruction models, unlike fine-tuned Qwen choice/state/relief groups. Qwen7B in a generic protocol MODELS list is not evidence of evaluation in these exported groups.
